prayerExcerpt.en-US: If God be in your heart, He will be also on your lips; for Christ has said, "From the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Se Deus estiver em teu coração, estará também em teus lábios; pois Cristo disse: "Da abundância do coração fala a boca."

meta.face: An Andalusian of about sixty with a sun-browned olive complexion and a LONG, NARROW, SMOOTH OVAL face after Zurbarán — a high, narrow forehead, a very LONG, THIN, straight nose with a slight DROOP at its tip, SMALL, soft, dark ALMOND eyes under THIN, HIGH-arching black brows, gently hollow cheeks, a SMALL, pursed, closed mouth, a LONG, NARROW chin; CLEAN-SHAVEN; black hair greying at the sides in the Franciscan crown; the gaze turned a little aside, mild and humble. Not the angular, moustached paschal_baylon, the bony, bald peter_alcantara, the round frei_galvao, the broad benedito or the heart-shaped nicholas_tolentino.
meta.basis: No portrait from life survives. Zurbarán's St. Didacus (English Wikipedia's lead) paints a lean friar with a long, narrow, clean-shaven face and a long nose, which the card follows; the cross is from the book, which has him die embracing it with the Dulce lignum on his lips. Zurbarán's roses, from a later legend, are left off.
